# `gcp.instancetemplate`

Resource that enables a convenient way to save a virtual machine (VM) instance's configuration that includes all of its properties and allows you to create a new instance from it.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/InstanceTemplate` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
